claims.evidence: Two-of-three (Rotterdam) rule with other causes excluded retrieved only from a review article (PMC) and a leaflet snippet; NHS diagnosis page text itself not retrieved, so 'The NHS says' unverified.

claims.evidence: Blood tests not confirmed in retrieved text. Review of guidelines says an ultrasound is not necessary when irregular cycles and raised male hormone signs are both present.
